content: Yesu yi Zakhayi
Yesu wákota mu Yediko amana wáhyokila muna mbanza.
Kwákala kwakuna yi mutu mosi, khumbu yandi Zakhayi; wákala pfumu wa bakalaki ka phaku, mvwama phi kákala.
Kakala sanda mu kumona keti nati kákala Yesu, kaasi kikuma kya mulumba-lumba wa batu, kálendaku kumumona, mukuma wakhufi kákala.
Hanga wénda thinu kuna thwala amana wázanza muna miti mosi ndangu kamumona, kikuma mwamuna kafwana kulutila.
Amana buna kátula Yesu homa meni yayina, wáthuta mesu ku zilu amana wámuzimbwala: «Zakhayi, tuluka tswatsu, bulungi, yikala lelu ku nzu yaku.»
Zakhayi wátuluka tswasu mu kumuyamba yi kyesi kyosu.
Amana mu kumona bwabuna, boosu bányengalakana: «Wendi kala ku nzu ya musumuki.»

Kaasi Zakhayi, wamutendendi, wuzimbudi kwena Pfumu: «Pfumu, yihána kwena batsukami kati-kati dya kuvwa kwama, amana yukani yihuna mu kulutula thalu ya kosu kima kina kwena mutu, yimúvutwala mbala ya.»
Yesu kámuzimbwala: «Lelu luhulusu lwisi kikuma kya nzu yayi, mukuma yandi phi kenina mwana mosi wa Bulahami.
Mukuma, Mwana wa mutu kisa sanda yi kuhulula kina kyátota.»
Kingana kya makuta ma wolu
Bwosu bakala yuka bima bina, Yesu wáyika hika kingana kimosi kikuma bela-bela yi Yelusalemi kákala, amana bakala banza ni Kipfumu kya Nzambi fwani kyamonika muna tangwa meni dina.
Hanga wuzimbudi bwabu: «Mutu mosi wa kikanda kya lukumu wénda ku tsi ya kyana, mu kumuyadika kipfumu kya hata dyandi; ku nima dya kuvutuka.
Amana kahanga wutedi kumi dya basadi bandi, wubaheki mafwalanga kumi ma wolu. Amana wábazimbwala: "Sadilenuzoku bikhita tii yi kuna yikwisa vutwakila."
Kaasi bakwa mulambu wandi bakala mumenga, amana bátuma kibuka kimosi kya bambambala ku manima ma yandi, ndangu benda zimbula kuna mbanza yina kenda: "Betu tuzodiku: mutu yandu katuyala."
"Buna kávutuka, kunima dya kumuyadika kipfumu, hanga wutedisi basadi bana káheka makuta, ndangu kazaya keti bweti básadilama.
Watheti wísa amana wázimbula: "Pfumu, fwalanga dyaku dya wolu dilumbudi makwawu kumi."
Pfumu wámuzimbwala: "Bwa bukheti, wenina musadi mosi wa bukheti kikuma wuhwidi mwani mu mambu ma khunda; watámbula kipfumu ha thandu ya mbanza kumi."
Wazodi wísa amana wázimbula: "Pfumu, fwalanga dyaku dya wolu dilumbudi matanu makwawu."
Pfumu wámuvutwala: "Ngeyi, phila mosi, wakála pfumu wa mbanza tanu."
Wahika wísa, amana wázimbula: "Pfumu, tala di, fwalanga dyaku dya wolu dina yízindika ha kitemba.
Mukuma ngeyi mbangiki, kikuma ngeyi wena mutu wa mathata. Wisi bonga bima bina wusikudiku amana wisi hela bina wukuniku."
Pfumu wámuzimbwala: "Muna ndinga zaku meni zina yi mwana yikúfundisila, musadi wa mbi! Wázaya ni meni mukwa mathata. Yisi bonga bima bina tsikudiku; yisi hela phi bina khuniku.
Amana kikuma kya biki wakonda sila mbongu zama mu nzu yina bisi vudisila mbongu? Mu kuvutuka kwama yikakwenda bongaza yi muluta."
Kunima wázimbula kwena batu bana bákala hana: "Mubotulenudyoku fwalanga dya wolu amana hekenudya kwena wuna wena yi mafwalanga kumi."
Bámuzimbwala: "Pfumu, yandi mafwalanga ma wolu kumi kenina mawu kedi!"
Yandi wávutula: "Yiluzimbwadibwa: bayíka kwena wuna wena yi bima; kaasi wuna kondi kima, bamúbwotula keti kina kena kyawu.
Kaasi kwena bambeni bama, bana bazodikiku ni yibayala, banatenu kwaku amana bazengenu tsingu ha mesu mama."»
Yesu wukoti mu Yelusalemi
Kunima dya kuzimbula bwabuna, Yesu wénda ku thwala bawu amana wátombuka ku Yelusalemi.
Tangwa kátula bela-bela yi mahata mama: Betifasi yi Betaniya, bela-bela yi mongu wa Olive, wátuma bodi ba balonguki bandi,

wubazimbwadi: «Alwenda kuna hata dina dyenina kuna sambwa; ha lwakóta, lwamóna mwana wa ane mosi wuna bisi zanza batu, wakuzitikila; wuna bakonda zanza kedi keti mbala mosi kwena mutu. Mukutumunenu amana munatenu.
Yukani mutu kaluhyula: "kikuma kya biki lubati mukutwamina?", lwamúzimbwala bwabu: "Pfumu mupfunu kamuvi."»
Bana kátuma benda amana báwana mambu bwosu kábazimbwala.
Tangwa bakala kutumuna mwana ane
, bakwa yandi bábazimbwala: «Kikuma kya biki lubati kutwamina mwana wa ane?»
Bávutula: «Pfumu mupfunu kamuvi.»
Amana bámunata mwana wa ane kwena Yesu, kunima bátimbula miledi mya bawu hana kunda dya mwana wa ane, amana bámuzanzisa Yesu.
Tangwa kakala kwenda, batu bakala yala mizaka mya bawu muna nzila.
Amana kakala bwesuka ku khulumuka ya mongu wa ba Olive tangwa bakala sangwala kibuka kya balonguki, bakala zatula Nzambi mu ndinga ya ngolu, kikuma kya biphadi byosu bina bámona.
Bakala zimbula: «Kasakumuka wuna wisi kwisila mu khumbu ya Pfumu! Ngemba mu zilu yi khembu muna bisoka!»
Amana ndambu ya Bafwadisi, muna mulumba-lumba wa batu, bámuzimbwala: «Mulongi, bakaya balonguki baku.»
Yandi wábavutwala: «Yiluzimbwadibwa, yukani bawu badibata, matadi makálunga!»
Yesu wudidi kikuma kya Yelusalemi
Amana mu kubwesuka, Yesu wámona mbanza amana wádila kikuma kya yawu,
mu kuzimbula: «Wadi ngeyi phi wázaya, mu kilumbu kyaki, abweti kutambula ngemba! Kaasi buthwena moosu makusweka mena ku mesu maku.
Mukuma bilumbu byakwísa, kwena ngeyi, bina bakúzyeta buna bufwani kwena bambeni baku amana bakúzinga yi kukufitikisa muma mwosu.
Bakúbula, ngeyi yi bana baku mu kati dya ngeyi, amana basísaku mu kati dya ngeyi keti tadi ha thandu ya tadi, kikuma wázayidilaku tangwa dina kisi kutala Nzambi!»
Yesu muna nzu ya Nzambi
Amana buna kákota mu nzu ya Nzambi, wáyandika kukula batu bana bakala tekisa bima.
Mu kubazimbwala: «Básonika bwabu: "Nzu yama, yakála nzu yimosi ya bisambu." Kaasi benu, lukitudiya saka dya bandwandwa.»
Yesu kakala longa bilumbu byosu muna nzu ya Nzambi. Amana bambuta ba banganga Nzambi yi balongi ba mitsiku yi bapfumu ba bikanda bakala sanda phila ya kumuhondila.
Kaasi bázayaku ketibwe bahanga, mukuma batu boosu bákangama yi yandi mu kumuyuka.

footnotes.text: Muna bikalulu bya bikanda byahika, mbisi wuna ane bakala musadila hanga mbisi wuna wisi tikula mazitu. Kenina wakhunda kuluta baphunda bana bakodini. Bisi muzayila muna matu mandi ma kaleyi. Ane kenina kidimbu kya kudikulumuna kwa Masiya.
